messages.subject: Meridian / Harcourt – MSSA mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena, Sarah,

Our mark-up attached (v2), tracked. The principal points for your client:

1. Liability – general cap to the greater of 200% of trailing fees or £1.5m; data-protection / confidentiality breaches to be UNCAPPED (or at the very least a high multiple of the annual fee).
2. Payment terms – 60 days to match Harcourt's standard cycle (you have 30).
3. Renewal notice – reduced to 60 days.

Our client feels strongly on the data-security recourse. Happy to have a call.

Martin

Sarah
